import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric and remove commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove negative values from flipper_length_mm
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Remove out-of-range values for flipper_length_mm
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    avg_body_mass = cleaned_df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_body_mass
